description: Compute the odds of winning a lottery for various prize tiers. Use for awareness, education. Inputs: numbers to pick, total numbers, bonus number config. Returns probability and 1-in-N for each tier. See list_bundles for related 'jeux-probabilites' calculators.

bonus_numbers.description: Number of bonus/powerball numbers to match (default 0)

bonus_pool.description: Size of the bonus number pool (default 0, no bonus)

total_numbers.description: Total numbers in the main pool

name: calculate_lottery_odds

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

reference_url.description: Link to a calcul2 page documenting the calculation in detail.

result.description: Computed result. Object whose fields depend on the tool (e.g. {tax, marginal_rate, brackets} for tax tools, {volume_l, gallons} for volume tools).

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").

title: Calculate Lottery Odds
